bibl.title: Attributes, Vestments, Context and Inscription in the Identification of Nubian Paintings: Proposing the ‘Multi-Layer’ Image Recognition Method.
bibl.seg: Magdalena Łaptaś, Attributes, Vestments, Context and Inscription in the Identification of Nubian Paintings: Proposing the ‘Multi-Layer’ Image Recognition Method.
bibl.note: Presents a method that enables identification of Nubian paintings whose tituli have not been preserved or are incomplete. - The attributes. - The vestments. - The context. - The inscriptions. - Conclusions.
